title: Brewing and Baking
description: The food and drink mod, updated from Cherries!
body:
Brewing and Baking Updates Cherries! to 1.21.11 and NeoForge!

Brewing and Baking - The food and drink mod!

Brewing and baking aims to overhaul the minecraft food and potion system with more interesting and interactable gameplay.


Features:

Cherries - Dropped from cherry trees

Cherry Pie and Jam - Craftable Consumables

Coffee - Custom Coffee Plants and brewing processes

Chocolate - From processing cocoa beans


Version 1.2.1


Dependencies:
 - NeoForge >=21.11.38-beta for Minecraft 1.21.11

Compatability:
 - Custom JEI recipe management


Check out the [source](https://github.com/philippesic/brewing-and-baking) to submit issues and contribute
